title: MushR: A Smart, Automated, and Scalable Indoor Harvesting System for Gourmet Mushrooms
authors: Anant Sujatanagarjuna; Shohreh Kia; Dominique Fabio Briechle; Benjamin Leiding
notes: Published 2023-08-01 in Agriculture 13(8), 1533. CC BY 4.0. Mask R-CNN on oyster mushrooms. 91.72% is final training accuracy; test bbox AP 61.88, segm AP 49.33. Appendix A cites raw dataset slug; project README links annotated slug.

title: Hybrid Feature Engineering and Artificial Neural Network for Mushroom Fruiting Bag Contamination Classification
authors: John Vincent R. Bacanto; Jennifer C. Dela Cruz; Noel B. Linsangan
notes: Studies healthy, green mold, black mold fruiting bags from Laguna, Philippines. Uses ResNet-18+CBAM/GLCM/ANN, reporting 86.9% accuracy. Direct same-task prior work, not C01 reuse.

title: Automating Mushroom Culture Classification: A Machine Learning Approach
authors: Hamimah Ujir; Irwandi Hipiny; Dayang NurFatimah Awang Iskandar; et al.
notes: Studies Pleurotus ostreatus culture contamination classification (1400 images). Related domain prior work, not C01 reuse.
